title: Coefficient unit and canonical shifts of the specified realization
statement: Fix a prime l, a field k of positive prime characteristic distinct from l, and the supplied scalar-extension realization Data D for the canonical universe lift of Q_l. For every separated finite-type quasi-compact k-scheme T the actual completed regular coefficient in degree zero belongs to the integral bounded constructible complete category. There is a sectionwise coefficient inclusion into the ordinary restricted closure regular module, equal on sections to the completed coefficient inclusion followed by the specified encoding and closure map. The realization of the completed regular coefficient is isomorphic to the closure regular module in degree zero, with composite through normalizationComparison transposing under normalizationAdjunction to exactly normalizationDerivedInclusion. The integral category is stable under every integer ambient shift. For every integer n there is a natural isomorphism between the shifted integral realization and the ambient shift of the realization, whose component is normalizationComparison inverse at the shifted object, followed by normalizationModel.commShiftIso and the shifted normalizationComparison. These are precisely the fields of RealizationProperties [def-pur-condensed-exceptional-reconstruction-data, def-pur-exceptional-realization-normalization]. No compactification, exceptional adjoint, supplied tower, naturality of exceptional comparisons or refinement appears in this assertion.

proof.text: The completed regular coefficient has constant rank-one finite reductions, quotient cocycle and invertible completion unit, so it is integral bounded constructible complete. Shifting a K-flat representative shifts all reduction intervals, preserves etale origins, and preserves the reconstruction unit because the actual total derived limit commutes with shifts.

Construct the coefficient inclusion sectionwise from the completed coefficient map, encoding and closure map. Scalar restriction retains these actions. Its derived adjunction transpose is multiplication B tensor_A A to B, inverse b to b tensor 1; the balancing relation proves both composites are identities. Exact encoding and flat scalar extension compute this map on the regular single complex. Compose its asIso with normalizationComparison inverse. The homEquiv inverse identities and cancellation of normalizationComparison prove the exact coefficientUnit_normalized equation.

The natural scalarExtension comparison whiskered by the inverse encoding and closure scalar functors gives a natural normalizationComparison. Whisker its inverse by integralShift, compose with normalizationModel.commShiftIso restricted along the integral inclusion, and then with the shifted normalizationComparison. This defines the natural shifts isomorphism. Computing its components, the functor associators and unitors cancel, leaving exactly the required normalization equation.
